note: r14w (macmini, 2026-11-21; starts only on the lead's approval): r14t's chain (r14u's headwall cap) with wall_band_clip after part_move in place of drive_band_clear. Each on-road retaining_wall triangle (wall_near_lane v3c's test) is cut against the clearance prism (deck plane -0.05 .. +4.6 m) of every drivable deck it crosses; parts beside the road, under it and above clearance stay; parts above clearance become p2_headwall pieces. The keep list (wall_band_keep_r14w.json, 281 places found on a test copy where the cut opened a hole / unsupported or hanging edge / void) leaves those walls uncut; they stay counted, reasoned as 'overlapping decks at different heights / low clearance'. New stop d_lane_void (driver-height openings within 3 m of a lane edge, new vs r14t). Test copy of r14t (r14wtest6): walls 359.6 m (r14t 2506.6, live 1666.7, v3c), new unsupported 0, hanging 0, void regression 0, lane holes 0.
